notes: Residential subdivision infrastructure set for Hawks Valley Phase 4 (City of Madison project 11773). The document is a SCAN — 19 of its 28 pages carry no text at all — except sheets U-5 (Sanitary Sewer Schedule) and U-6 (Storm Sewer Schedule), which are vector. This truth covers only those two schedules; the water main, plan & profile, erosion control and detail sheets are raster and were not enumerated, so completeness is 'partial' and the `water` and `erosion` categories are deliberately empty rather than guessed. Pipe quantities are the schedules' PLAN (PAY) LGTH totals, summed per size across all three streets. The storm schedule also gives a PIPE LGTH column (structure wall to wall, 3-17% shorter than pay length depending on size), so storm pipe tolerances are widened to 0.10 — and to 0.20 on the single 30" run, where the two readings differ by 17% — so that either defensible reading scores as correct. Sanitary has only one length column, so those are tight. Sums (plan/pay feet): sanitary 8" = 138+140+66+250+220+185 = 999; storm 36" = 90; 30" = 36; 24" = 256+258+39+55 = 608; 18" = 31+60 = 91; 15" = 31+114+55 = 200; 12" = 31+37+32+29+14+12+49 = 204.
